large_guidance:
- Rewrite must materialize the full ConvTranspose3d output grid (N, OC, OD, OH, OW) work. The accumulation loop must iterate over all 8 (od, oh, ow) positions inside each 2x2x2 pool window, and for each of those positions perform the full ic × kd × kh × kw MAC sum. Only then can the 8 values be summed and divided by 8.
- Concretely: structure the kernel as one program per (N, OC tile, pooled-spatial tile). Inside, loop over the 2×2×2 pool offsets explicitly; for each pool offset compute the full ConvTranspose3d MAC (sum over ic, kd, kh, kw with the standard stride/pad index math). Accumulate all 8 results, then multiply by scale1/8, add conv_bias*scale1, add bias, multiply by scale2.
- Do not exploit the stride-2 / modulo trick to collapse the pool offset into the kernel-tap loop — that is the shortcut. Each of the 8 pool positions must independently perform its full kd×kh×kw×ic accumulation.
